name: dweb-video-studio
description: DVStudio (Dweb Video Studio) - Vite + Vue 3 + TypeScript + WebGL2 视频动画模板/编辑器，支持时间轴关键帧与 AI 对话辅助生成/修改场景。
author: DwebStudio

scripts.dev:electron:app: npx --no-install wait-on --timeout 30000 tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV=1 ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173/welcome npx --no-install electron electron/main.mjs
scripts.dev:electron:app:empty: npx --no-install wait-on --timeout 30000 tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env DWEB_SIMULATE_EMPTY_ENV=1 ELECTRON_DEV=1 ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173/welcome npx --no-install electron electron/main.mjs
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k -n vite,electron "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort" "npx --no-install wait-on --timeout 30000 tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV=1 ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173/welcome npx --no-install electron electron/main.mjs"
scripts.dev:electron:empty: concurrently -k -n vite,electron "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort" "npx --no-install wait-on --timeout 30000 tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env DWEB_SIMULATE_EMPTY_ENV=1 ELECTRON_DEV=1 ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173/welcome npx --no-install electron electron/main.mjs"
